name: moving the Flow worker between hosts
from: The Leader places Flow on a different host, or a host loses the signed-in browser.
to: The source worker is masked, both states are backed up, the states are merged without overwrite, one host is recorded as the owner, the destination job is pinned and exclusive, and an operating-observation record states before, after and reversal.
cost: Bounded operator attention; no credit is spent.
otherwise: Two hosts share one Google session, or orders and journals are lost or duplicated in the move.
receiver-condition: The thread's assayer, or an office of its opener, reads the evidence (the allowance plan and idle record, the hold and recovery result, or the migration report and operating-observation record) and accepts or declines it; the lead never receives its own work.
